credits.title: THIS SYMPHONY MAY CONTAIN HOPE.
credits.overview: RAYE brings her acclaimed album THIS MUSIC MAY CONTAIN HOPE. to the big screen in a breathtaking orchestral experience filmed at London’s Royal Albert Hall.
